recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken, Sweet Potato & Broccoli
ing: 1.5 lbs chicken breasts (these are for Friday — see step 6)
3 tbsp olive oil · 4 cloves garlic, minced
2 tsp smoked paprika · 1 tsp cumin · 1 tsp chili powder · 1.5 tsp salt · pepper

steps.t: Oven to 425°F. Two sheet pans — don’t crowd them. Crowding steams instead of roasts.
Toss sweet potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and a third of the spice mix. Spread on pan 1. Roast 15 min alone.
Toss the thighs and breasts with 1 tbsp oil, the garlic, and half the remaining spice.
Pull pan 1, push potatoes aside, add all the chicken. Back in.
Toss broccoli with the last tbsp oil and remaining spice. Pan 2, roast 18 min alongside.
Pull the breasts at 165°F — around 18 min. Leave the thighs until 175°F, around 22 min. Rest everything 5 min.
Shred the breasts, container them separately. That’s Friday’s wrap and Saturday’s lunch.
Divide the rest into 3: ~8 oz thigh meat, one potato’s worth, a third of the broccoli.

recipes.note: Thighs for the leftovers, breasts for the wrap. Thighs reheat without turning to rubber, which matters when you’re eating this three times. Breasts shred better cold and the Caesar dressing carries them.

steps.t: Medium-high, splash of oil. Onion and pepper, 4 min.
Add turkey. Break it up, cook until no pink, ~7 min.
Taco seasoning + 1/3 cup water. Simmer 3 min until it thickens.
Squeeze in half a lime and stir. Off the heat.
Microwave both rice pouches.
Three containers: rice base, turkey on top. Keep the yogurt out.

extra.label: Add when you eat
items: 2 tbsp Greek yogurt — your sour cream, same texture, 3g protein instead of 0

recipes.name: Sirloin, Rice & Green Beans
ing: 1 rice pouch · 1 bag microwave green beans

steps.t: Pat dry, salt both sides generously. Let it sit while the pan heats — 10 min of salt beats any marinade.
Cast iron on high until it just starts to smoke. Thin film of oil.
Steak in. Don’t move it. 3–4 min per side for medium.
Last minute: smashed garlic clove and a pat of butter, spoon it over.
Pull at 135°F for medium. Rest 5 full minutes — cutting early dumps the juice.
Rice and green beans in the microwave while it rests. Slice against the grain.

recipes.note: Not feeling steak? Shrimp (thaw under cold water 5 min, cook 4) or pork tenderloin medallions. Same sides, same slot.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
ing: 2 cups Caesar greens + half the dressing packet

steps.t: Grab ~6 oz of the shredded breast you set aside Monday.
Toss with 2 cups Caesar greens and half the dressing packet.
Pile into a high-fiber tortilla with a sprinkle of the parmesan. Roll tight.

recipes.note: Half the packet. The full dressing is most of the calories in that kit, and half is plenty once it’s tossed.
